title: Julie Fleischer (Forbes 50 Entrepreneurial CMOs) — 'a provocative and compelling read'
summary: Julie Fleischer — named to Forbes 50 Entrepreneurial CMOs, global insights and analytics leader, board member and advisor — endorses Incorruptible on LinkedIn: 'an essential new look at what makes businesses succeed long term.' Frames the book around governance, mission-driven alignment, and stakeholders-before-shareholders as the antidote to financial gravity.
blockquote:
I am devouring Eric Ries's latest work: #Incorruptible. It's an essential new look at what makes businesses succeed long term. He writes about the critical impact of good governance, what it takes to be truly mission-driven and aligned, and the prioritization of stakeholders before shareholders as a way to drive returns and escape financial gravity.

It's a provocative and compelling read.
